notes.title: Soccer in a Box: Awards, Discounts, and a New Game!
notes.notes:
Dear Gamers and Friends,

We’re thrilled to share some exciting news with you all! 🎉 Our game, Soccer in a Box, has been nominated for "Mechanic Magic" and "Better Together" awards at the prestigious BiteMe Game Awards 2024! This is a huge honor for us, and we couldn't have done it without your support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207720/b0f3c8b60b39a9ba79688903efe12681208645fa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207720/fa4699f6a473b49c0ab8cdfed51b1f1b7b721491.png[/img]

Soccer in a Box is now available at a 15% discount! Grab a friend, jump in, and experience the fun together - it’s the perfect time to team up and enjoy the magic.

But that’s not all! We’re also excited to introduce our latest game: Nine-Ball Roulette! 🎱
It’s an online billiards game for up to 4 players, designed to deliver the most thrilling and competitive gameplay experience. If you’re a fan of pool, Nine-Ball Roulette is a must-try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207720/adaef62098cf722cdfb70087d6699f3bc3256cc8.png[/img]
[i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3376250/NineBall_Roulette/]Nine-Ball Roulette on Steam[/url][/i]

Thank you for being part of our journey. We hope you continue to enjoy our games and share the joy with friends.

Stay tuned, keep gaming, and may the best team win!

Warm regards,
WaveBox Labs

notes.title: "Soccer in a Box" is now released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207720/6c1f3c3f83ccc4fd8bdbb9064e8df20caacdb23c.png[/img]
Hello, fellow players,

After the trial during the new product festival, we received a lot of feedback and made some optimizations. Today, "Soccer in a Box" is officially released!

Main updates (compared to the demo):

[list]
[*] Added a regional filter in the lower left corner of the room list.
[*] Added a settings button in the room.
[*] Optimized the volleyball map to make it more enjoyable.
[*] New balls: Banana/Paper Airplane/Dragonfly/Shuriken.
[*] A large number of new appearances.
[*] A large number of new dances.
[*] Supports up to 8 players.
[*] More "intelligent" bots (better than humans).
[*] Improved game stability.
[*] The top of the room list now shows friends' rooms.
[*] Supports more languages and optimized fonts for various languages.
[*] Fixed the issue of controller adding bots and changing positions conflicting.
[/list]

If you have any suggestions or questions, feel free to contact wavebox66@gmail.com.

Wishing all players a great gaming experience!

notes.title: "Soccer in a Box" is now available as a demo
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow soccer fans!

We have just launched the demo version of "Soccer in a Box". Welcome everyone to come and try it out!
[h2]About the demo version[/h2]
The demo version also supports online games and most game functions. Here are the differences between the demo version and the official version:
[*] There will be a demo prompt in some places.
[*] Limited dances/appearances.
[*] Each room supports up to 4 players.
[*] The full version includes more game content (ball/court/environment)

I hope you have fun playing, and I also hope you click [b]Add Wishlist[/b] button:)
If you encounter any problem, please let us know via wavebox66@gmail.com
